sections.title: Welding
body: Welding is an essential skill for structural integrity and occupant safety after a collision. Improper welds can lead to repair failures and safety risks. That’s why OEM network and Direct Repair Program requirements demand certified welding technicians.

image.alt: Welders in a bodyshop practicing proper welding techniques during collision repair welding training

sections.title: Benefits of I-CAR Welding Training & Certification

cards.title: Theory Instruction
cards.body: Train on welding techniques through theory instruction

cards.title: Hands-On Coaching
cards.body: Receive instructor-led, hands-on practice and coaching

sections.title: Different I-CAR Welding Certifications
sections.cardColumnClass: col col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-3 pt-1 mt-3 pt-md-3

cards.title: Steel GMA Welding
cards.body: Focused on Gas Metal Arc (MIG) welding for steel components

cards.title: Steel Sectioning
cards.body: Covers proper sectioning and joining techniques for structural steel repairs

cards.title: Aluminum GMA (MIG) Welding
cards.body: Designed for aluminum-intensive vehicles and OEM-approved MIG welding processes

sections.title: Network Requirements for Welding Certification
body: Many OEM-certified and insurance networks require I-CAR welding certification.
Meeting these standards ensures compliance and customer confidence.

image.alt: Welder in a bodyshop using proper welding techniques during collision repair as mandated by network requirements

sections.title: Get Ready for Welding Training
body: Confirm your shop is ready for certification.

cards.title: Facility & Equipment
cards.body: Prepare with facility set up and proper welding equipment

cards.title: Technician Experience
cards.body: Ensure your tech has completed online and hands-on course prerequisites

cards.title: Policy Compliance
cards.body: Verify your shop meets all I-CAR welding standards and safety requirements.

sections.title: Access RTS Welding Resources
body: Stay current with Repairability Technical Support (RTS) for welding procedures.
Access OEM guidelines, step-by-step instructions, and troubleshooting tips.

image.alt: Collision repair technician in a bodyshop viewing the RTS website for welding techniques, tips, and guidelines

sections.title: Start Your Welding Certification
body: Get certified and build the skills needed to make safe, quality repairs.
